page.layout: One scanned page: a plain vellum or limp binding cover, blank, with no printed text. Only stains, spots, a worm-like mark and wear are visible.
page.notes: The scan shows the outer cover of a book bound in limp vellum or similar parchment, not a printed page. No text, headings, running heads, page numbers or signatures are printed. Dark spots at the upper and lower left edge are binding holes or ties, and brownish spotting in the centre is staining. Nothing is transcribed.
